originality.rationale: The source 1303.0568 studies exactly the polynomial and supplies the cubic, but its main theorem classifies permutations only (q ≡ 1 mod 8). It does not state the complementary q ≡ 3 mod 8 complete image/fiber census. The 2014 sequel treats general-coefficient permutation classification and does not contain the stated nonpermutation multiplicity distribution in its inspected theorem and proof material. Targeted published-finding corpus semantic searches returned no equivalent result; limited literature coverage leaves risk of a stronger previously known 3-to-1 polynomial theorem.
residual_risks: A more general finite-field 3-to-1 mapping classification may subsume the exact counts despite not being located in these searches.
The 2013 cubic reduction is existing mathematics and must not be presented as a new derivation; novelty is the counted nonpermutation fiber distribution.
